Diseases due to blood sucking lice. Can be divided into three conditions:
Pediculosis capitis (head lice), which is caused by Pediculus humanus var.
capitis; Pediculosis corporis (body lice) caused by P. humanus var. corporis
and Phthirus pubis (pubic lice) caused by Phthirus pubis.
The arthropods are transmitted from human to human via:
Direct contact; Sharing of combs, brushes, towels (P. capitis); Sharing clothing
(P. corporis); Sharing underwear and Sexual intercourse or any intimate
personal contact (P. pubis).
